business_problem: Wuzhi needed an automated way to turn large volumes of paper-based and highly varied documents into accurate, searchable, and structured digital assets for government and enterprise customers without long manual processing cycles.
solution_summary: Working on Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan platform, Wuzhi Technology built an end-to-end document-intelligence pipeline for digitizing paper archives and turning them into structured knowledge assets. The system combines OCR, layout analysis, large-model visual understanding, structured extraction, vectorization, and graph-database storage so scanned documents can move from image files into searchable semantic records. After recognition and layout parsing, the large model interprets document meaning, extracts target fields, and stores normalized outputs in a graph-backed knowledge layer. Vector embeddings then support hybrid search and multi-route retrieval, which Wuzhi uses to power downstream applications such as AI authoring, AI search, and AI voice assistants connected to customer knowledge bases and business systems. The result is a single flow for document ingestion, structuring, retrieval, and content generation rather than separate tools for each step.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the language and vision capabilities used to interpret, structure, and generate content from documents.

solution_components.name: Intelligent OCR
solution_components.role: Extracts text from scanned and photographed paper documents so they can enter the processing pipeline.

solution_components.name: Layout Analysis
solution_components.role: Parses page structure so tables, sections, and reading order can be understood correctly.

solution_components.name: LLM Visual Understanding
solution_components.role: Interprets document meaning and supports structured extraction from complex visual layouts.

solution_components.name: Graph Database
solution_components.role: Stores normalized document entities and relationships for later retrieval and knowledge applications.

solution_components.name: Hybrid Search and Multi-route Retrieval
solution_components.role: Serves the processed documents back to search, authoring, and assistant applications with high recall and precision.

data_flow: Paper documents are scanned and passed through OCR and layout analysis, then Qianfan-based vision and language models extract fields and semantics into structured records. Those records are stored in a graph database, embedded through vectorization, and exposed through hybrid search and multi-route retrieval so AI search, writing, and voice-assistant applications can return grounded answers and generated content.
business_outcome: Wuzhi shortened delivery cycles for document-digitization projects, improved extraction accuracy, cut manual labor, and created reusable search and authoring experiences on top of the same structured knowledge foundation.
metrics: Error rates dropped by more than 50%.
Work that previously took months can now be completed within weeks.
Writing and revision efficiency improved by more than 30%.
The solution generated millions in profit returns for customers.
architecture_clues: The solution uses both language understanding and visual understanding to process paper documents end to end.
Structured outputs are stored in a graph database rather than left as flat text files.
Vectorization and multi-route retrieval sit downstream of extraction so the same corpus can drive search, writing, and assistant applications.
